Upgrades: Boundary Incursion,Heavy,Pummeler,Double Time,Ghosting,Immolator,Slideshot,Shell Packer x5,Double Barrel
Comments: Slideshot is the best upgrade in the game. The upgrade does not actually require you to slide, instead if you are in the air, repeatedly tap crouch while sprinting to continuously proc Slideshot. Pummeler is also bugged, so if you bind your reload to your fire key (both together), then you can gain its fire rate without the downside of charging. Ghosting is also the other upgrade which makes this weapon amazing as it gains pierce.

Comments: Nothing to really say here, we spawn the weapon and hold left click to fire. It melts the boss. Sadly, since its a heavy weapon, we have to bring the Caustic Grenade for Heavy Support, otherwise Incendiary Grenade would be insanely better.

Upgrades: Boundary Incursion,Burning Tips,Fan Fire,Home Cooking,Modded Auto,Lucky Bastard,Lucky Last,Double Action,Big Fat Doobie,Shrapnel Loading
Comments: The Lead Flinger buffs absolutely picked this weapon out of poverty. Gaining elemental damage to self on Home Cooking makes this weapon go from C tier to S tier. The general mechanics here are that we hold left click to fire and watch RNG take place until the target dies. this weapon has always had problems with gambling (since thats its identity), but it is much more consistent now.

Upgrades: Boundary Incursion,Frantic Fingers,Hard Ricochet,Firmly Planted,Ballistic Charger,Tinderbox,Unarmored,Thumper,Hull Piercer,Yellow Prism,Green Prism
Comments: Since Hull Piercer is the best dps option, we are forced to take Frantic Fingers and Tinderbox. Firmly Planted makes the explosions bigger so we take that, and use Ballistic Charger as our actual main dps because without it, our kill times skyrocket. Hard Ricochet allows us to gain more charge when the bullets get incidental second hits. The main thing here is that while there was a change that allows you to now hold reload to use Frantic Fingers and Tinderbox, it is still higher DPS to mash.

Upgrades: Boundary Incursion,Fire Shot,Corrosive Reaction,Compressed Ammunition,Rot Advantage,Tread the Line,Fire in the Hold,Gunpowder Finale,Gunner's Precision,Squadron,Broadside,Ungovernable,Plasma Arc
Comments: This build is not great in a proper mission setting. The idea is to utilize the Globbler with The Glob and Pressure Cooker to instantly apply acid to ourselves, thus allowing Corrosive Reaction to work. We use fire on the Weapon because we can use Elemental Cocktail to utilize Rot Advantage. This frees up the grenade slot to be Incendiary Grenade for its massive damage buffs. The bug we are abusing is Plasma Arc + Broadside, which allows double plasma projectiles while aiming. Since most of the best upgrades on Trident are rares (blues) maximizing Tread the Lines size is the most important step.

Upgrades: Boundary Incursion,Autocycler,Trifecta,Kinetic Amplifier,Arc Lightning,Heavy Hitting,Pulverizer,Hot Swap,Coronal Ejection
Comments: The best of the worst builds. DMLR's Autocycler has no AOE so we are limited to actually using it in the Amalgamation Hunt. The entire strategy is hold left click to fire, you have infinite ammo. We also bring Photon Disc with Bullet Time since it can generate ammo for us. Normal element also frees up some slots as opposed to fire so we will take it.

The bug we are abusing is Plasma Arc + Broadside, which allows double plasma projectiles while aiming. We use fire on the Weapon because we can use Elemental Cocktail to utilize Rot Advantage. Comments: Globbler is still amazing at its job, it just got knocked into place to be a more average weapon. We are shooting the ground instead of direct fire after the first shot [to get it on the ground] to get flood procs. The 3 other main mechanics here are we want to take damage purposefully on the first shot to fully charge Impact Funnel, before each shot we want to melee so as to count as a "weapon swap" for Globulous Excitement, and lastly we want to fully charge our Pressure Cooker for each shot.

Comments: Since Hull Piercer is the best dps option, we are forced to take Frantic Fingers and Tinderbox. Missile Bay isnt really a build i like to run because you are wasting slots for auto aim instead of damage. but if you want to run it theres nothing stopping you. Since we have replaced our projectiles with missiles we run Point Demolition since we lose AOE anyway. The main thing here is that while there was a change that allows you to now hold reload to use Frantic Fingers and Tinderbox, it is still higher DPS to mash.

This was originally removed from the upgrade as a synergy, but we begged hard enough to get it back since it was awful without it.

We use Photon Disc instead of Incendiary Grenade since it will be more consistent damage for this build rather than relying on fire saturation from the enemy for Give and Take and Focus Prism. You need to constantly be air sliding for Grenade Belt, watching your Grenade Cooldown, and Fungal Skewer Cooldown, in order to survive.
